source.name: Sports Business Journal
source.quote: Citizens Bank has scheduled a press conference for noon ET today in Philadelphia to take the wraps off a 25-year, $95M naming rights deal

note: Arena naming rights: Citizens Bank Park. Reported as a 25-year, $95M package; the article says $57.5M is for the naming rights and the rest for media, tickets and hospitality. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2003.
